name: find-horizontal-space
script: find text "\\h+" in "x " & tab & " y" with regexp and string result syntax "PCRE"

name: find-lines
script: find text "^\\w+$" in "one" & linefeed & "two" & return & linefeed & "three" with regexp, all occurrences and string result syntax "PCRE"

name: find-singleline-flag
script: find text "^\\w+$" in "one" & linefeed & "two" with regexp, all occurrences and string result regexpflag {"SINGLELINE"} syntax "PCRE"

name: find-pattern-not-multiline
script: find text "(?-m)^\\w+" in "one" & linefeed & "two" with regexp, all occurrences and string result syntax "PCRE"

name: find-line-endings
script: find text "^x$" in "x" & (character id 8232) & "x" & return & "x" & return & linefeed & "x" & (character id 133) & "x" with regexp, all occurrences and string result syntax "PCRE"

name: find-dot-newline
script: find text "a.b" in "a" & linefeed & "b" with regexp and string result syntax "PCRE"

name: find-dotall-flag
script: find text "a.b" in "a" & linefeed & "b" with regexp and string result regexpflag {"DOTALL"} syntax "PCRE"

name: find-word-accents
script: find text "\\w+" in "café naïve" with regexp, all occurrences and string result syntax "PCRE"

name: find-case-insensitive
script: find text "élan" in "ÉLAN" with regexp and string result without case sensitive syntax "PCRE"

name: find-emoji-position
script: find text "b+" in "😀bb" with regexp syntax "PCRE"

name: find-lookbehind
script: find text "(?<=\\$)\\d+" in "cost $42" with regexp and string result syntax "PCRE"

name: find-keep-out
script: find text "foo\\Kbar" in "foobar" with regexp syntax "PCRE"

name: find-possessive
script: find text "a++b" in "aaab" with regexp and string result syntax "PCRE"

name: find-recursion
script: find text "\\((?:[^()]|(?R))*\\)" in "x(a(b)c)y" with regexp and string result syntax "PCRE"

name: find-negated-class-newline
script: find text "a[^x]b" in "a" & linefeed & "b" with regexp and string result syntax "PCRE"

name: find-named-using
script: find text "(?<y>\\d{4})-(?<m>\\d\\d)" in "on 2026-09" using "\\k<m>/\\k<y>" with regexp and string result syntax "PCRE"

name: find-not-found
script: find text "z" in "abc" with regexp syntax "PCRE"

name: change-backreferences
script: change "(\\w+)@(\\w+)" into "\\2 at \\1" in "me@home you@work" with regexp syntax "PCRE"

name: change-dollar-references
script: change "(?<user>\\w+)@(\\w+)" into "${2}:${user}" in "me@home" with regexp and dollar references syntax "PCRE"

name: change-empty-matches
script: change "x*" into "-" in "abc" with regexp syntax "PCRE"

name: change-lines
script: change "^" into "> " in "one" & linefeed & "two" with regexp syntax "PCRE"

name: splittext
script: splittext "a1b22c" using "\\d+" with regexp syntax "PCRE"

name: filter-text
script: filter text "^(\\w+) is (.*)$" in "John is ten" & linefeed & "Anna is twelve" key "\\1" using "\\2" syntax "PCRE"

name: re-compile
script: re_compile "(?<=\\$)\\d++" syntax "PCRE"

name: re-compile-error
script: re_compile "(unclosed" syntax "PCRE"

name: flag-find-longest
script: find text "a" in "a" with regexp regexpflag {"FIND LONGEST"} syntax "PCRE"

name: flag-dotall-onigmo
script: find text "a" in "a" with regexp regexpflag {"DOTALL"}

name: syntax-lowercase
script: find text "\\h" in "x y" with regexp and string result syntax "pcre"
